verses.1: May your people be comforted. May your gods say: “Comfort them!”
verses.2: Speak out in the hearts of Jerusalem, and call upon her. For her army is full; for her punishment is desired. For she has taken away from Jehovah all her sins.
verses.3: The voice of the reader in the desert calls out through the mouth of Jehovah. May He restore us to our true nature, so that we may be worthy of being called children of God.
verses.4: All hills will be leveled, and all mountains and valleys will be flattened. They will become a path for people to walk on, and slopes will become flat surfaces.
verses.5: And the glory of Jehovah was revealed, and all creatures saw it together, because Jehovah’s words were spoken.
verses.6: The voice said, “Call out!” And it was said, “What shall I call out? All the animals in the field, and all His blessings, like the stars in the sky.”
verses.7: The wild goats are eating the grass. The birds also eat it, because the spirit of Jehovah has settled in them. Now, the wild animals have eaten up the grass.
verses.8: The wild deer will be hunted, and the words of our God will be made eternal.
verses.9: On the high mountain, I climb up to you, O Zion. With my voice, I cry out to you. O Jerusalem, do not be afraid! I say to you, “Look, these are your gods.”
verses.10: Look, the throne of Jehovah is strong; he will come. His seed will inherit it. Look, his reward and his actions are before him.
verses.11: When it sprouts, it will cause harm; in its shoots, it will bear flowers. And in its heart, it will carry fruit that will bloom.
verses.12: He measured the seas and the skies with his scales. He also weighed all the mountains and hills in his balances.
verses.13: Who can bear the spirit of Jehovah? And who can know His counsel?
verses.14: Who will guide him? He must be taught and understood. He must be taught the ways of judgment and how to navigate through life.
verses.15: They were also like people from Middeli. When their ears were cut off, they became islands like those that are destroyed by fire.
verses.16: And in Lebanon, there is no end to suffering; and its life has no hope.
verses.17: All the nations are like islands that stand against the force of evil. They are considered to be in a state of chaos.
verses.18: And to whom shall I be compared? And what resemblance shall I have in them?
verses.19: The throne was covered with gold, and its edges were also covered with gold. It was adorned with golden decorations.
verses.20: The cautious person will choose a tree that will not wither. He will find a wise man who can prepare a framework for it, so that it won’t be destroyed.
verses.21: Do not know, do not hear, do not understand from the beginning. Do not comprehend the principles that govern the earth.
verses.22: He will sit upon the throne of the earth, and its inhabitants will be like beetles that crawl across the surface of the sky. He will make it a place for worshiping God.
verses.23: He who gives judgments to the judges of the earth, as Jehovah has commanded.
verses.24: Even if they were planted, even if they were sown, even if they grew roots in the earth, their seeds would still be destroyed. There would be a storm and chaos that would destroy them.
verses.25: And to whom shall I compare Him? And He will say, “Kadoch.”
verses.26: Open your eyes and see who created these beings. They are numbered among all the creatures, each with a name. They are extremely powerful and strong; no one can resist them.
verses.27: What will Jacob say? What will Israel speak? My ways are hidden from Jehovah and from His gods. My judgments remain unknown.
verses.28: Do you not know? If you hadn’t heard it from the God of worlds, Jehovah who creates the ends of the earth, then you wouldn’t have known. There’s no way to understand His ways.
verses.29: Give the yaelaf strength, and let those who have no strength increase in numbers.
verses.30: And boys will go away, and they will suffer in the wilderness when they are lost.
verses.31: And the power of Jehovah will be changed. They will rise up, and they will desire to go forward, but they will not be harmed. They will go on their way, and they will not stop.
